assets.title: SNES — Super Mario World example
assets.description: The cartridge with a restored Super Mario World label, top title and rear details, plus standalone front and rear label exports for the shared neutral shell. An example of how the same shape takes on its identity.

assets.title: Nintendo 64 — NTSC-U/C cartridge
assets.description: The original North American gray Game Pak with a smooth bowed crown, recessed rear wordmark, domed security screws and continuous connector guide. Front and rear labels are unprinted.
assets.rights: Original contributions: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Nintendo product design and marks, including official 2D letter contours in the approximate molded rear wordmark, are excluded. No game artwork or source photography is included.

assets.title: NES — early five-screw cartridge
assets.description: The early western gray Game Pak with five rear screw seats, a ribbed front channel, a folded top label and a recessed 72-contact connector. Both labels are unprinted.
assets.rights: Original contributions: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Nintendo product design and marks are excluded; no game artwork or source photography is included.

assets.title: Nintendo 64 — Super Mario 64 reproduction
assets.description: Super Mario 64 on the refined North American cartridge, with a smoother crown, recessed rear wordmark and detailed connector. The K-A front label and 1996 rear label retain unmodified photographic pixels; source resolution and color remain approximate.
assets.rights: Original modeling contributions only. Nintendo artwork, marks, product design and source photography are excluded; attribution and the maintainer's request do not grant rights to those elements. See CREDITS.md and NOTICE.md.

assets.title: NES — Super Mario Bros. reproduction
assets.description: Super Mario Bros. on the early five-screw cartridge, with the round gold seal, folded top title and rear warning label without REV-A. Unmodified source photography preserves visible wear; the top fold has limited detail.
